snippet.title: The Falconeer: Revolution Remaster Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Experience the epic aerial combat RPG on all platforms from December 2nd. Explore haunting landscapes, engage in epic dogfights, and uncover ancient secrets in a visually enhanced, rebalanced edition of the BAFTA-nominated, award-winning original.

The Remaster includes:
 - Improved flight controls, animations and collisions.  
- Balances and changes to escort missions and those idle downtimes.
- A filled up world.
- Edge of the World expansion content now included in the base game. 
- Additional new content, voice overs and much more.
